{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The request bytes are first dispatched to the proxy parser before any HTTP method or path processing."},

{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1176,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"HTTP parsing resumes immediately after the proxy header, so a crafted header length or malformed line can shift the HTTP parser onto attacker-chosen bytes."}
]
